checks: Counterexample: B=(u,w)=0 has completed branch ring k[[v]]. In the right end chart u=t^N v^(N-1), w=tv, its strict transform t=0 is transverse to E_(N-1):v=0 and away from the chain node. The preassigned w vanishes on B, so the old literal ideal(w^ell) is not a finite jet.

For N>2 the simultaneous power-series substitution has identity linear part and an inverse constructed degree by degree in every characteristic. It respects the Z/N grading, including nonreduced mu_N, and therefore gives an automorphism of the invariant A_N presentation.

The formula wprime=w+a v+b u+a b w^(N-1) is exact. At the right end, xprime/(yprime)^(N-1)=(t+a)/(1+b v^(N-2)t^(N-1))^(N-1), so the exceptional coordinate is translated by a. The left formula is symmetric and translated by b; because N>2 the opposite correction vanishes on that end.

On every interior E_j, the relative corrections have orders N-1-j and j-1, both positive. All component labels and valuations j,N-j,1 are preserved. End parameters a,b independently avoid a finite set, while interior attachment coordinates stay unchanged.

For N=2, two independent linear forms avoiding the finitely many P1 directions give an equivariant coordinate change even in characteristic two: mu_2 has equal weights on x,y, and the Veronese parameter xprime/yprime is still a coordinate. No etaleness of mu_N is assumed.

In adapted coordinates the divisor of wprime is the exceptional component with multiplicity one near each attachment. Thus k[[wprime]] is the actual completed smooth branch ring, and m_B^ell=(wprime^ell) has length ell. Distinct attachment points on one component retain distinct leading epsilon values.
The individual I_a module decomposition and fractional Hom calculations apply in the new presentation. The ordered-pair isolators and exact min-order bounds are unchanged, including p dividing N.
The intrinsic T depends only on branch ideals and the unchanged indices. Consequently the inverse-Cartan reflection and Schur bounds are exactly unchanged, as are the isolated/no-attachment cases.

The Artinian full-bundle framing proof tensors this fixed intrinsic T. Its k[[w]] tensor identity now uses the adapted uniformizer, which is a legitimate fixed branch-ring identification; no family-coordinate choice is needed.

The preceding two-coordinate-axis Hom theorem already uses u and v as branch parameters and requires no repair. The downstream unresolved summary invokes only intrinsic finite jets and their existing actual-bundle scope.
